conf.comment: AD FS verbose audit detail (299/324/403/404/410/411/412/413/500/501), Security channel, provider 'AD FS Auditing'. Per-event-id label-prefixed regex extraction over the rendered Message, per catalog recommendations.direct.cribl. The recommended stateful 501->411 fold by Instance Id is NOT implemented: Cribl's 'join' function requires a pre-existing stageId store object, which is out of pipeline scope (confirmed empirically against this instance) - see README gap. Records are emitted per-event, tagged with adfs.audit.instance_id, for a downstream stateful process to reassemble.
